title: DSPy Core Abstractions
summary: This module defines the foundational building blocks for DSPy programs, including base modules, signature definitions, standardized data types for LM communication, and adapters for integrating with various Language Models.

nodes.label: BaseModule Class
nodes.title: BaseModule Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionalities like parameter management and state persistence.

nodes.label: Module Class
nodes.title: DSPy Module Class
nodes.description: The primary base class for building DSPy programs, extending BaseModule with execution logic, LM interaction, and lifecycle management.

nodes.label: DSPy Predict Module
nodes.title: DSPy Predict Module
nodes.description: A specialized DSPy module responsible for making predictions using a language model, often built upon the core Module class.

nodes.label: Define DSPy Signatures
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Metaclass
nodes.description: The metaclass that dynamically creates and validates DSPy Signature classes, handling field ordering, type inference, and instructions for LM prompts.

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: Pydantic's BaseModel
nodes.description: The foundational class from Pydantic that provides data validation, settings management, and serialization, which DSPy signatures build upon.

nodes.label: LM Request Structure
nodes.title: Language Model Request
nodes.description: Defines the standardized structure for requests sent to a Language Model, including messages, tools, and configuration parameters.

nodes.label: LM Response Structure
nodes.title: Language Model Response
nodes.description: Defines the standardized structure for responses received from a Language Model, containing generated text, tool calls, and metadata.

nodes.label: System Message Type
nodes.title: System Message
nodes.description: A specific type of message within an LMRequest, used for providing model-level instructions or context to the Language Model.

nodes.label: Base Custom Data Type
nodes.title: Base Class for Custom Types
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all DSPy custom data types (e.g., Audio, Image), ensuring they can be formatted for LM consumption.

nodes.label: LM Streaming Handler
nodes.title: Language Model Streaming Handler
nodes.description: Manages the incremental streaming of Language Model events and responses, allowing for real-time processing of generated content.

nodes.label: Base Adapter Interface
nodes.title: DSPy Base Adapter
nodes.description: Defines the core interface for transforming DSPy inputs and signatures into LM calls and parsing LM outputs, integrating native LM features.

nodes.label: BAML Adapter
nodes.title: BAML Adapter
nodes.description: A specialized adapter for rendering complex Pydantic models into compact, human-readable schemas for LMs, optimizing structured output generation.

nodes.label: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.title: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.description: Orchestrates a two-stage process: a main LM generates a response, then a smaller LM extracts structured data from the raw output.

nodes.label: External LM Client
nodes.title: External Language Model Client
nodes.description: Represents an external Language Model client (e.g., OpenAI, LiteLLM) that DSPy adapters interact with for generating responses.

groups.label: Program Foundations
groups.title: Core Program Building Blocks
groups.description: Defines the fundamental classes for constructing DSPy programs and modules, including the base module and specialized prediction components.

groups.label: Interaction Definitions
groups.title: LM Interaction Definitions
groups.description: Establishes how DSPy programs define and structure their interactions with Language Models, leveraging Pydantic for robust schema definition.

groups.label: Data Exchange Structures
groups.title: LM Communication Data Structures
groups.description: Provides the standardized data formats for sending requests to, receiving responses from, and handling streaming data from Language Models.

groups.label: LM Integration Adapters
groups.title: Language Model Integration Layer
groups.description: Contains the core interfaces and specialized implementations for adapting DSPy programs to various Language Model APIs and managing their interactions.
